description: Apply naming changes across the app: Replace 'BC agent' with 'BC Supervisor' in strings, replace 'Agent' label with 'Supervisor' where it refers to a role, and add BCBF Code field display in the report header/general section. The employee_code login field stays as-is (it is the login credential, not the role label).
steps: 1. In strings.xml, change: (a) ckcc_group_observation from 'BC agent observation' to 'BC Supervisor observation', (b) ckcc_group_recommendation from 'BC agent recommendation' to 'BC Supervisor recommendation', (c) label_agent from 'Agent' to 'Supervisor', (d) visit_section_recommendation from 'Agent recommendation' to 'Supervisor recommendation'.
2. In strings.xml, add new string: <string name="label_bcbf_code">BCBF Code</string> and <string name="visit_bcbf_code">BCBF Code</string>.
3. In VisitFormData.kt, add field: var bcbfCode: String = "". In toFieldMap(), add: putIfNotBlank(fields, "bcbf_code", bcbfCode).

4. In VisitReportActivity.kt setUpGeneral(), after the village field binding, add binding of the BCBF Code field: bindText(binding.inputBcbfCode) { form.bcbfCode = it }. Pre-fill from the session user's bcCode if available.

5. In activity_visit_report.xml inside the General section card, add a TextInputLayout for BCBF Code after the village field, with hint '@string/visit_bcbf_code'. Give it id fieldBcbfCode with EditText id inputBcbfCode.
6. In VisitDetailActivity.kt render(), where it displays bcCode, also handle displaying the BCBF Code. Update the label_bc_code string to 'BCBF Code' from 'BC code'.
7. Update the string label_bc_code from 'BC code' to 'BCBF Code' in strings.xml.
8. Verify no tests break due to label changes. Run all unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: All instances of 'BC agent' in visible UI text now read 'BC Supervisor'
The label 'Agent' (where it refers to a role, not a person's name) now reads 'Supervisor'
A BCBF Code field appears in the General section of the visit report form
BCBF Code is serialized to the field map as 'bcbf_code'
The detail view shows 'BCBF Code' label instead of 'BC code'
findings: All naming changes applied successfully. BC agent -> BC Supervisor in ckcc_group_observation, ckcc_group_recommendation, ckcc_od_group_observation, ckcc_od_group_recommendation. Agent -> Supervisor in label_agent and visit_section_recommendation. BC code -> BCBF Code in label_bc_code. New visit_bcbf_code string added. bcbfCode field added to VisitFormData with serialization. BCBF Code TextInputLayout added to General section in layout. Hindi translations updated correspondingly. Build and tests pass.
